sentences.text: This is a foundation test for the studio, not the next film.
A keeper walks to the lamp, planting every step, and takes the lantern by its handle.
When she lifts it, the lantern unfolds into a star, and every shadow in the room turns to follow the new light.
Through the window, a second world was waiting all along.

identities.role: test actor: full-body gesture, reach, grip, facial change
identities.design_intent: original adult night-keeper, long coat with a stiff collar, short asymmetric bob, narrow shoulders, big boots
folded paper lantern on a hook; unfolds into a five-point star light source

identities.role: interior with a window that contains a complete second world
identities.design_intent: cool night interior, oblique table and shelf, window to a moonlit hill town

scenes.understanding_after: a held object can become the scene's light source
scenes.main_event: keeper walks to the hanging lantern, grips the handle, lifts it; lantern unfolds into a star; shadows re-aim
scenes.causal_mechanism: the grip transfers the lantern to the hand socket; lifting raises the light; the star is the new key light so every attached shade plane rotates toward it
scenes.start_composition: wide interior, keeper enters screen left at 0.18 width, lantern hangs at 0.62 width
scenes.end_composition: medium, keeper centre holding star overhead, face lit, shadows below the forms

events.what: keeper starts walking from the left; the first foot lifts while the other stays planted
keeper settles under the lantern, weight shifts back, head tilts up
right hand reaches the handle and closes; lantern leaves the hook
arm raises the lantern overhead, torso stretches, eyes follow
lantern outline morphs into a five-point star, core flares
key light swings from the window side to overhead; shade planes rotate

camera.what: slow push in and tilt up with the lantern

scenes.handoff: camera drifts toward the window; the star's light spills into it
unacceptable: shadow planes stay fixed while the light moves
star is a cross-fade instead of a geometry change

scenes.understanding_after: the window holds a complete second world
scenes.main_event: camera pushes into the window; the inner world parallaxes independently of the room and fills the frame
scenes.causal_mechanism: the window is a portal mask over a complete inner world with its own depth layers

events.what: camera accelerates toward the window centre; room layers outpace the inner world
window rim passes the frame edge; inner world now owns the screen

unacceptable: inner world is a flat sticker
rectangle seam visible at the rim
